1.c4 e5 2.Nc3 Nf6 3.g3 Bb4 4.Bg2 O-O 5.N.strategy: Gets the king to safety before the centre opens. White is ready to answer an advance of Black's e-pawn by moving the attacked knight, after which the bishop on g2 bears down the long diagonal on the pawn.

Gains space and attacks the knight on f3, which has to move. The pawn cramps White and is supported by the rook and the f6-knight, but it is also a target for the knight on c3 and, once the knight leaves f3, for the bishop on g2.
